purpose: This table holds hourly weather observations for the three New York-area airports (JFK, LGA, EWR), combining per-hour atmospheric readings (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway).
usage: Read the table at the grain of one row per airport per UTC observation hour (airport_code, observed_hour_utc); join to flight or other airport-keyed data via airport_code, and filter or aggregate over observed_hour_utc or observed_date_local for time-based analysis. Sparse columns such as wind_gust_mph, pressure_mb, and wind_dir_degrees should be treated as optionally present rather than always populated.
limitations: The profile could not confirm which column set is the true identifying key; the declared grain (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) is inferred from distinct counts and a near-matching cross product (13023 vs. 13014 actual rows) and should be confirmed by the deterministic grain measurement. wind_gust_mph (74.6% null), pressure_mb (11.5% null), and wind_dir_degrees (1.7% null) are sparse and their missingness pattern was not explained by the profile alone. captured_at is retained as a profiled column with only 3 distinct values despite not being flagged as airbyte metadata in the profile; its inferred role as a pipeline load timestamp should be reviewed. The meaning of airport_elevation_ft and airport_longest_runway_ft as static per-airport attributes versus per-row measurements was inferred from their low cardinality (3 distinct values matching the 3 airports) rather than stated explicitly.
